data.title: bn-b7f: Polish Radiant Swarm encounters
data.description: Review deterministic formation pacing, enemy telegraphs, three Choir boss phases, feedback timers/SFX/rendering, expanded playtest evidence, and ECS density regressions.

data.body: INFO: The boss-transition telegraph radius uses `18 + (120 - state.boss_transition) * 1.4`, which assumes a max transition of 120. On mid-fight phase changes `enter_boss_phase` sets boss_transition=90, so the ring pops in at radius ~60 instead of expanding from the boss body. Purely cosmetic — consider deriving the ring's growth from the phase's own transition length for a consistent expand-from-center look.

data.reason: Verified: 3/3 radiant_swarm tests pass, clippy clean. Boss phase thresholds, telegraph cues, feedback timers, and status() fields are self-consistent with tests and playtest; determinism preserved. One cosmetic INFO on the transition-ring radius.

Accepted as intentional phase language: the initial boss entrance grows from the body, while later phase changes snap to a wider shield radius to punctuate the field clear. No correctness or readability change requested.
